summary.text: Lauren Ventrella is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 65, which the legislature's member page lists as covering East Baton Rouge Parish. First elected in 2023, Lauren Ventrella sits on the Commerce, Judiciary, and Natural Resources and Environment committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Lauren Ventrella's occupation as attorney, with a J.D. and M.P.A. from Southern University and a B.A. from Louisiana State University.

The House page lists Lauren Ventrella's committee assignments as Commerce, Judiciary, Natural Resources and Environment, and House Select Committee on Women and Children, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Capital Region Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus, and Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation.
